verdict.rationale: Convex provides official client SDKs (TypeScript/JavaScript, React, React Native) documented across its core docs, plus HTTP API for other languages, CLI tooling, and an official MCP server verified hands-on via probe. This directly supports AI-native developers building against first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of SDK quality beyond first-party docs, and explicit documentation of SDKs for languages beyond JS/TS (e.g., Python) if they exist.
